_readme: Post wording for the social distribution engine (issue #281). Edit freely: this file is the whole copy engine's vocabulary. Variables: {{title}} {{summary}} {{section}} {{type}} {{url}}. A template only goes LIVE once "approved" is true; unapproved ones appear in dry-run previews only. Add "platforms": ["youtube"] (or bluesky, threads, facebook, x) to limit a template to some platforms; a platform with templates of its own uses only those. Set "retired": true to stop using one without deleting it. Card platforms (Bluesky, Threads, Facebook) show the link as a preview card, so {{url}} is optional there; X and YouTube drafts get the link appended when a template leaves it out. Full notes: scripts/social-blast.md.
